hints.title: Stars and Bars Representation
hints.text: Distributing S non-negative candies among 3 children without constraints equals (S + 2) * (S + 1) // 2.

hints.title: Inclusion-Exclusion Principle
hints.text: Let L = limit + 1. The forbidden condition is that one or more children receive at least L candies.

hints.title: Counting Violations
hints.text: Total = C(n) - 3 * C(n - L) + 3 * C(n - 2L) - C(n - 3L), treating C(x) as 0 when x < 0.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Looping up to n = 10^8 is too slow.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Apply Principle of Inclusion-Exclusion with stars and bars.
